game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Underground River, a black underground river: the shadow ranger must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Stamina Climb: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop.
theme: Shadow Cave – Underground River: a black underground river
core_gameplay_loop: In Underground River, repeat each round: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop. Each round, cave spiders strike the rope bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stamina value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the rope bridge from cave spiders in Underground River: keep the stamina meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: stamina drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Stamina Climb
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stamina Climb' (Week 4 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Underground River'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stamina changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cave spiders in Underground River.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while stamina > 0.
